blocks.html: New unit owners at Robinsons Land Corporation (RLC) Luxuria, Residences and Communities projects need not worry about who to call to do the finishing touches inside their new homes.
Ring Rob Concierge, realizing new owners will want to customize the interiors of their units according to their personal preferences, has just added Fit Out Service to its menu of services.

Instead of calling different contractors to do the ceiling, tiles, cabinet and other things needed to turn their new places into their dream homes, unit owners only have to get in touch with Ring Rob Concierge to find the right people who will turn their ideas into reality. Ring Rob has partnered with professional and experienced contractors to help unit buyers undertake essential changes to their properties to make them truly their own.

Services offered by Ring Rob Concierge are design, detailing and construction drawing, as well as interior fit out services, which include ceiling, tile, painting, doors, cabinets, electrical fixtures and lighting, air-conditioning cladding, wall accent and plumbing. Ring Rob Concierge can also customize to suit the unit owners personal tastes and preferences. The work will be completed in at least 30 days, depending on the size of the unit.

Unit owners do not even have to worry if they are unable to supervise personally the customization work. A Ring Rob Concierge officer will supervise and monitor and will be in constant and close coordination with the contractor to ensure the quality of work.

Launched in January 2013, Ring Rob Concierge is an extensive online service request platform exclusive to residents of Robinsons Luxuria, Residences and Communities to help ensure that unit owners enjoy a convenient and hassle-free lifestyle. It currently offers over 70 services, from housekeeping, laundry, carwash, repairs and preventive maintenance, storage, trucking to online food delivery.
Unit owners can access the country’s first and only digital concierge anytime and anywhere through the official website, www.ringrobconcierge.com, or through the free Ring Rob mobile app, available on the App Store and Google Play.
